name: VSS96
description: A 28-layer Maxwell mantle with a uniform core and a homogeneous elastic lithosphere. Used in Spada et al. (2011) test 6/1 to check that codes agree on a multistratified model, where the root-finding of the viscoelastic normal mode method becomes hard.
used_by: spada2011 test 7/1 (as an alternative to M3-L70-V01)

source.citation: Vermeersen, L. L. A., Sabadini, R. and Spada, G. (1996). Analytical visco-elastic relaxation models. Geophysical Research Letters 23, 697-700. The layer table used by the benchmark is the file VSS96.dat distributed from the COST ES0701 benchmark page.

notes: The 28 layer values are not reproduced here. The distributed file VSS96.dat is the authority and is inside the spada2011 archive; figure 1 of Spada et al. (2011) plots the profile against M3-L70-V01.
Reading VSS96.dat out of the archive and recording the table here is outstanding work.
